mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, it is a pleasant 74 degrees with clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School, under a waxing crescent moon.

The city recently wrapped up its I Voted sticker contest, choosing four student winners from kindergarten through 12th grade whose designs will be featured at polling places this November. Also, remember that the local police have been busy keeping our streets safe.

There is plenty to do in our community today including the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems and yoga classes at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or head to Lake Lou-ee for more trivia fun.
In a report from August 13, a 14-year-old was stopped and educated by officers after being found riding an electronic dirt bike on a public roadway.
Today's flavor is the delightful Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and the shop is open until 10 PM. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck at the Concerts at McKee event today between 5 PM and 9 PM.
